title: StitchVector 3.0 protection ablation: does fill protection systematically drop real ink? Pre-registration, pushed and remote-verified before test seeds 8001-8005 / 8101-8105 are generated.

hypotheses.A: grey contrast detects pale ink better than Lab contrast
hypotheses.B: fill protection drops ink that the existing contrast already sees

methods.M1: B2c + grey candidates, fill protection kept
methods.M2: B2c + grey candidates, no protection on added candidates, then the B2c luminance check
methods.M3: B2c + Lab dE candidates, no protection on added candidates, then the same luminance check

code: sv_pa.py (methods), sv_pa_run.py (synthetic + scenes), sv_pa_u2.py (u2 descriptive), sv_pa_diag.py (signal diagnosis)
fairness_note: grey |dL*| and Lab dE are different quantities; grey uses 5/8 (the value in the earlier diagnosis), Lab uses 8/12 (B2a / B0 values). Not tuned on test data. Equal numbers do not mean equal sensitivity.

dev_disclosure.earlier_diagnosis: before this freeze, in the same session, pale-line signal was measured on viewed data (protabl/pa_diag_viewed.json, sv_pa_diag.py): u2 G1/G2/G3 dE median 20/16/14 (noise p95 8.8), luminance share ~0.9, 59-64% of G2/G3 axis inside the protection mask; and an ad-hoc version of M1/M2 (and M2 + luminance) was scored on dev seeds 1201-1203 (pale recall 0.32 -> 0.40 / 0.79). Thresholds 8/5 were the only grey values tried.
dev_disclosure.no_change_after_dev: no parameter or rule was changed after the dev run

scene_note: scene kinds cover dark and pale ink, pale ink on a fill boundary, pale ink brighter than one / both sides, fill edges without ink, 3 and 6 px bands, ink crossing bands, mix-colour ink on a red/pink boundary (the closest available case to 'red line near a similar fill'). No new scene kind is added.

synthetic: visible-sample recall per line type (pale, red/black, width-varying, touching a fill) and overall
length precision = 1 - false length / detected length; false length split into fill edge / band / other
bands: axis share with a line on it, per band, and the count over 0.1
added candidates before and after the luminance check, by truth label
worst seed by recall and by precision
scenes: length precision and false length by place
band axis share mean and max
added candidates and kept by sub-type (brighter-than-side ink: candidate count vs kept count)
u2: descriptive: G1/G2/G3 coverage, red fault coverage, PN1/PN2 axis share with a line, added length far from Oracle traces

reading.targets: 97% recall / 97% precision remain the project targets, not this round's pass mark
reading.keep_candidate_if: in the test, pale recall clearly improves over M0, precision does not drop materially, and fill-edge / band false length does not rise widely; joint reading
reading.M2_vs_M3: if M3 is close to M2, prefer reusing the Lab path (fewer moving parts)
reading.if_unacceptable_false: stop, report where the false lines come from; no new protection rules in this round

stop_rule: one run on test seeds, <= 10 min CPU; no change after the first number; u2 run after the synthetic test
not_done: face layer, Oracle, VTracer, B0/B2c changes
